task: Correct ten programs below the unchanged full-library loudest-window RMS acceptance bound
status: Targeted actual-recipe audit passed; parent must rerun final-source all-library qualification and native builds
rationale: Sforzando Brass raises both rank LEVEL settings while retaining the fast upper accent, sustained-body envelope, and all excitation/filter/velocity settings. Neon Brass 18 inherits this correction.
Swell Strings scales baseline LEVEL and pressure-level depth by 1.25 together, preserving its pressure-swell proportions; Velvet Strings 38 inherits the correction.

Spiccato Strings raises both rank LEVEL settings and extends only the main decay control from 0.26 to 0.30 seconds. Both sustain levels remain zero, the short upper stroke remains 0.11 seconds, and attack/release controls are unchanged. Neon Strings 40 inherits the correction.

Clarinet scales rank level and touch level by 1.40 (rank II initial touch saturates at its authored maximum 1.0); Bass Clarinet scales corresponding controls by 1.55. Spectral touch, model, register, filters, pressure-vibrato, and attack/release controls are unchanged.
Metallic Keys increases the two rank LEVEL settings; body, strike, metallic ring balance, envelopes and spectral touch remain unchanged.

Dark FX 148 is the dark Thunder variation. Both rank LEVEL settings reach 1.0, and its low-rumble LP moves from 132.3 to 165 Hz, still below the 270 Hz source Thunder. The brief crack, long rumble decay and low-resonance character remain intact. The source Thunder is unchanged.

method.implementation: Exact existing measure() function included with renamed test main; no duplicated measurement formula. Before reproduces all ten failed values. After uses freshly compiled actual FactoryPresets.cpp with edited recipes.

probe.before_provenance_note: The before.tsv capture used the initial mode0/1/2 probe build, which was later overwritten when trial mode3 was added. Its exact executable hash was not retained. The retained pre-edit executable contains the same mode0 measurement and pre-edit linked core but additional mode3 trial controls; its hash is reported as a retained reproduction binary, not as the hash of the original baseline-producing executable. All ten baseline values independently match the parent full-bank failed audit.

limits: No native plugin or final piano-seam source qualification is claimed.
Level compliance and preservation of authored control roles do not demonstrate perceptual realism or acoustic equivalence.
Full bank audit, comparison provenance, and final platform builds remain parent responsibilities.
